nonPlantedFindings.note: Findings the deterministic layer reports that are NOT in SECURITY_FLAWS.md. Recorded so the corpus counts are explained, never credited to recall.

3.3.25.flaw: aws_availability_zones data source does not pin zone identity (zone-name/zone-id filter)

governance: This file is checked-in, human-reviewable DATA. It is the grading key for detection recall.
A flaw is 'detected' only if a finding fires with one of `detectedBy` IN THE STATED FILE.
`detectedBy: []` means NO Checkov rule catches this flaw. Those are recorded, not hidden.
Never relax an entry to make recall look better. Recall is a number we report, not a number we manage.
_meta.deterministicRecall: 21/25 (84%). The 4 misses are listed below with the reason each one escapes.
whyTheMissesMatter: On 3 of the 4 misses Checkov did not merely lack a rule -- it EVALUATED the flawed resource
and placed the check in passed_checks. It looked straight at the planted flaw and called it fine.
That is the argument for the hybrid design stated as a measurement: the deterministic layer is
not just incomplete, it is confidently wrong. These 4 are what the LLM layer is FOR.

tf-01-three-tier-webapp.missReason: Checkov's open-ingress rules are PORT-SPECIFIC: CKV_AWS_24 (22), CKV_AWS_260 (80), CKV_AWS_25 (3389), CKV_AWS_277. None covers 443. All of them evaluated this security group and PASSED. Requires the LLM layer.

tf-02-serverless-api.flaw: Lambda execution role with overly permissive DynamoDB policy (dynamodb:*)
tf-02-serverless-api.missReason: CKV_AWS_63 ('no IAM policy allows * as a statement's action') EVALUATED this policy and PASSED it. It matches only a bare '*'; a service-scoped wildcard like 'dynamodb:*' sails straight through. CKV_AWS_355 checks Resource:'*', and this policy scopes Resource to a real table ARN -- so the resource is tight and the ACTION is wide open, which is precisely the shape no Checkov rule catches. tf-02/iam.tf produces ZERO Checkov findings. Requires the LLM layer.

tf-02-serverless-api.flaw: Cognito user pool without MFA enforcement
tf-02-serverless-api.missReason: CKV_AWS_366 (Cognito MFA) EXISTS in checkov 3.2.500, EVALUATED this user pool, and placed the check in passed_checks. A true false negative: Checkov looked at the planted flaw and said it was fine. Requires the LLM layer.

tf-02-serverless-api.flaw: Lambda environment variables without KMS encryption
